summary: Iteration 25 - Multi-Method Authentication System. Tested 3 login methods (Email OTP, Email+Password, Phone SMS OTP) with proper UI prioritization. All 14 backend tests passed (100%). All frontend auth flows working correctly.
test_type: New Features - Multi-Method Authentication, Email Billing Notifications

test_categories.details: Send OTP, verify OTP, invalid email rejection, login existing user
Send OTP, invalid phone rejection, verify OTP flow
Login with password, invalid credentials rejection
Registration with email OTP (skipped - no mock OTP)
Staff login, create bill with email notification

tests.name: Auth Modal - 3 Login Methods
tests.details: Email+OTP (Best badge, teal border), Email+Password, Phone+SMS OTP (SMS charges warning)

tests.name: Email OTP Flow
tests.details: Email input → Send OTP → 6-digit OTP verification → Change email/Resend options

tests.name: Phone SMS OTP Flow
tests.details: Phone input with +91 prefix → SMS charges warning → OTP verification → Change number/Resend options

tests.name: Password Login Flow
tests.details: Email/Password inputs → Login button → Forgot password redirects to Email OTP

auth_modal_3_methods.details: Auth modal shows 3 login options with clear priority: 1) Email+OTP (Best badge, teal border, recommended), 2) Email+Password (traditional), 3) Phone+SMS OTP (reduced opacity, SMS charges warning)

email_otp_auth.details: POST /api/auth/email-otp/send sends OTP via Resend (or mock fallback). POST /api/auth/email-otp/verify verifies OTP and returns verification_token. POST /api/auth/email-otp/login allows passwordless login for existing users.

phone_sms_otp_auth.details: POST /api/auth/otp/send sends OTP via Twilio Verify (or mock fallback). POST /api/auth/otp/verify verifies OTP. Twilio is configured and active.

password_auth.details: POST /api/auth/login with email/password. Forgot password redirects to Email OTP flow for password-less reset.

registration_with_otp.details: POST /api/auth/register creates user. Registration can be done after email or phone OTP verification.

email_billing_notifications.details: When bills are created via /api/staff-billing/create-bill with patient_email, send_email_invoice() is called as background task. Email includes professional invoice with bill details, items, totals, discounts.

mocked_data.email_otp: When Resend API is not configured, mock OTP is returned in response for testing
mocked_data.phone_sms_otp: When Twilio is not configured, mock OTP is returned. Currently Twilio IS configured and active.
mocked_data.email_billing: Email notifications use Resend API. If not configured, notification is logged but not sent.

critical_code_review_comments: All 3 auth methods implemented correctly with proper UI prioritization
Email OTP is marked as 'Best' with teal border - correctly prioritized as free option
Phone SMS OTP shows warning about SMS charges - good UX
Forgot password redirects to Email OTP flow - smart password-less reset
Email billing notifications implemented in staff_billing.py send_email_invoice()
Twilio Verify is configured and active for SMS OTP
seed_data_creation: Created test bills with email notifications during testing
